subject.title: fix(cron): preserve delivery thread id type across SQLite round-trip

question: Should cron runtime reload treat `job_json.delivery.threadId` as the authoritative type source before falling back to `delivery_thread_id` for existing SQLite rows?
rationale: The patch is narrow and tested, but it changes persisted cron row reconstruction semantics for upgraded databases and should be an explicit compatibility choice.

options.title: Accept `job_json` as type source
options.body: Land the PR as-is because `job_json` already stores the config projection and the patch covers numeric, string, and null split-column rows.

options.title: Ask for release-row proof
options.body: Require one copied v2026.6.11-style state DB proof before merge if maintainers want more confidence on shipped rows.

options.title: Choose schema migration instead
options.body: Pause this PR and require an explicit typed column or migration design if `job_json` should not be authoritative.

recommendation.title: Accept `job_json` as type source
recommendation.body: Land the PR as-is because `job_json` already stores the config projection and the patch covers numeric, string, and null split-column rows.

likelyOwner.reason: The cron SQLite row codec and config projection history point to this owner as the best available compatibility decision owner.
